checklist.text: Boards are free of checks and loose knots

steps.title: Select stock
steps.instruction: Pull the rough boards for every species in the design and check each one for checks, wind, and loose knots.

checklist.text: Reference face is flat before planing

steps.title: Mill stock
steps.instruction: Joint one face and one edge, then plane every board to the same milled thickness.

steps.title: Rip Walnut strips
steps.instruction: Rip the Walnut strips (S1, S7) at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

steps.title: Rip Hard maple strips
steps.instruction: Rip the Hard maple strips (S2, S4, S6) at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

steps.title: Rip Cherry strips
steps.instruction: Rip the Cherry strips (S3) at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

steps.title: Rip Walnut strips
steps.instruction: Rip the Walnut strips (S5) at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

checklist.text: Write S1 on the Walnut strip
Write S2 on the Hard maple strip
Write S3 on the Cherry strip
Write S4 on the Hard maple strip
Write S5 on the Walnut strip
Write S6 on the Hard maple strip
Write S7 on the Walnut strip

steps.title: Mark the strips
steps.instruction: Write each strip label on its reference face so the design order survives handling.

checklist.text: Position 1: S1
Position 2: S2
Position 3: S3
Position 4: S4
Position 5: S5
Position 6: S6
Position 7: S7
Every joint closes with no gap

steps.title: Arrange and dry fit
steps.instruction: Lay the strips out in design order with reference faces up, then dry clamp to check the joints.

checklist.text: The dry fit closed cleanly

steps.title: Glue and clamp
steps.instruction: Spread glue on each joint, assemble the strips in order, and clamp evenly.

steps.title: Let the glue set
steps.instruction: Leave the panel clamped until the glue has set.

steps.title: Mark the reference triangle on panel P1
steps.instruction: Draw a triangle across the panel face so every wafer keeps its order and orientation after cutting.

measurements.label: Panel length consumed by the cuts

steps.title: Crosscut wafers from panel P1
steps.instruction: Set the stop block from the setup values and crosscut the panel into wafers, one cut per wafer.

steps.title: Glue the rows together
steps.instruction: Stack the rows in design order, top to bottom, spread glue on each joint, and clamp against a flat reference.

checklist.text: The trim lines sit inside the glued board on every side

steps.title: Square the board
steps.instruction: Trim the ends and sides square, removing the overhang, to reach the finished length and width.

steps.title: Surface to thickness
steps.instruction: Flatten and smooth both faces down to the thickness of the thinnest wafer.

steps.title: Finish the board
steps.instruction: Sand through the grits and apply food-safe finish.
